title: Cylindrical rod
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw the first loop as a rectangle with the following lines: the first line from the start point at [0.0, 0.0] to the end point at [0.0247, 0.0]; the second line from [0.0247, 0.0] to [0.0247, 0.0247]; the third line from [0.0247, 0.0247] to [0.0, 0.0247]; and the fourth line from [0.0, 0.0247] back to [0.0, 0.0]. Inside the first loop, draw a smaller rectangle for the second loop with the following lines: the first line from the start point at [0.0025, 0.0025] to the end point at [0.0222, 0.0025]; the second line from [0.0222, 0.0025] to [0.0222, 0.0222]; the third line from [0.0222, 0.0222] to [0.0025, 0.0222]; and the fourth line from [0.0025, 0.0222] back to [0.0025, 0.0025]. Apply a scaling factor of 0.0247 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Rotate the scaled sketch using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] degrees and translate it using the translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Extrude the two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units without extruding in the opposite direction, ensuring this operation creates a new solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical rod are length 0.024671052631578948 units, width 0.024671052631578948 units, and height 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.0247, 0).lineTo(0.0247, 0.0247).lineTo(0, 0.0247).close()

# Define the inner loop
inner_loop = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0.0025, 0.0025).lineTo(0.0222, 0.0025).lineTo(0.0222, 0.0222).lineTo(0.0025, 0.0222).close()

# Combine the outer and inner loops to form the final sketch
final_sketch = sketch.add(inner_loop)

# Extrude the sketch to create the 3D object
extruded_object = final_sketch.extrude(0.75)

# The final model
r = extruded_object

# Display the model

lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a rounded-square profile matching the top view (with small corner fillets)
w = 0.0247
rad = 0.0011

r = cq.Workplane("XY") \
    .moveTo(0.0, rad) \
    .threePointArc((rad, rad), (rad, 0.0)) \
    .lineTo(w - rad, 0.0) \
    .threePointArc((w - rad, rad), (w, rad)) \
    .lineTo(w, w - rad) \
    .threePointArc((w - rad, w - rad), (w - rad, w)) \
    .lineTo(rad, w) \
    .threePointArc((rad, w - rad), (0.0, w - rad)) \
    .lineTo(0.0, rad) \
    .close() \
    .extrude(0.75)
